subject: general
question: Express 0.overline{512} in the form (p)/(q), where p and q are integers and q ≠ 0.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To convert a **pure recurring decimal** to a fraction, write the **repeating digits** as the numerator.

For the denominator, write the digit **9** as many times as there are **repeating digits** in the decimal part.

Here, the repeating part is **512**, which has **three digits**.

∴ The fraction is 512 ÷ 999.

**∴ The correct answer is 512/999.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x = 0.512512512...

**Formula Used:** Multiply by 10ⁿ where n is the number of repeating digits.

⇒ Let x = 0.512512... — (Eq. 1)

⇒ Multiply both sides by 1000:

⇒ 1000x = 512.512512... — (Eq. 2)

⇒ Subtract (Eq. 1) from (Eq. 2):

⇒ 1000x − x = 512.512... − 0.512...

⇒ 999x = 512

⇒ x = 512/999

**∴ The correct answer is 512/999.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pure Recurring Decimal

A decimal in which all the figures after the decimal point are repeated. Example: 0.666... = 6/9 = 2/3.

Mixed Recurring Decimal

A decimal in which some figures do not repeat and some repeat. Formula: (Whole number formed by digits − Non-repeating part) ÷ (9 for each repeating digit and 0 for each non-repeating digit).

Rational Number Property

Every **recurring decimal** can be expressed in the form p/q, meaning it is always a **rational number**.</p
